text: 拉长20日周期，巴西市场ETF依旧保持强势，巴西ETF华夏上涨17.65%，巴西ETF易方达上涨17.63%，领跑全市场。能源化工板块延续上行趋势，能源化工ETF建信上涨12.08%。地产板块迎来修复行情，地产ETF华宝上涨6.54%，房地产ETF银华上涨6.14%。海外权益标的持续走强，美国50ETF易方达上涨5.56%，日经ETF华夏上涨5.52%；港股医疗板块也迎来持续修复，港股通医疗ETF永赢上涨3.98%。
text_en: Over a longer 20-day period, Brazil market ETFs have remained strong, with Brazil ETF China AMC up 17.65% and Brazil ETF E Fund up 17.63%, leading the entire market. The energy and chemicals sector continued its upward trend, with Energy and Chemicals ETF CCB up 12.08%. The real estate sector saw a recovery rally, with Real Estate ETF Huabao up 6.54% and Real Estate ETF Yinhua up 6.14%. Overseas equity targets continued to strengthen, with US 50 ETF E Fund up 5.56% and Nikkei ETF China AMC up 5.52%; the Hong Kong medical sector also continued to recover, with Hong Kong Stock Connect Healthcare ETF Yongying up 3.98%.
